title: Q-WORKERS-222: core/ui: tenant-agnostic design system (tokens, components, page shell, static a11y audit)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** issueloop and queue --run, daily
**Done check:** file:workers/core/ui/ui.test.js
**Status:** closed

Moved from ultrastable/workers#222 (workers repo archived; code now under workers/ here, issues disabled on this repo).

Owner role: operations. Done check: `core/ui` exports tokens, 23 script-free WCAG 2.2 AA components, a page shell and a static auditor; its tests pass; it names no tenant. Closing probe: `core/ui/ui.test.js` plus the first tenant (Practical Solutions) running it live with 0 axe violations.

Why: tenants are test beds. Practical Solutions needed a professional UI that scales to many domains; a generic UI kit is a platform capability, not tenant code (avoid the QNFO trap). Tenant-specific words, links, data and templates stay in the tenant.

Scope: pure functions from plain data to HTML strings; tokens with checked contrast pairs and a theme hook; `renderPage` shell with landmarks, canonical, Open Graph, JSON-LD, strict CSP headers; `auditHtml` structural checks (lang, title, h1, heading order, landmarks, labels, tables, no script, no external requests, size budget).

Prediction: n/a (new module; adoption measured by tenant conformance).

**Closing probe:** `file:workers/core/ui/ui.test.js`
